extractedText: Follett software inbound marketing pipeline conversion SDR workflow is a powerful yet simple process that helps businesses turn interested visitors into paying customers in a structured way. It focuses on capturing leads, getting them effortlessly through every single step of the sales pipeline. Unlike random attempts, this workflow provides the Sales Development Rep (SDRs) with a clear approach to follow and enhance conversions. But how does this system actually work behind the scene? And why does it fail to deliver the results that most businesses expect from it? In this guide, you will learn about each stage of the workflow and what SDRs do to grow your pipeline as well as some common challenges and mistakes. By the end, you will have a solid understanding on how you can use this workflow to boost efficiency, increase conversions and acheive more sustainable revenue growth. Here is the simple breakdown of Follett software inbound marketing pipeline conversion SDR workflow. Lead Generation: Companies write & publish service related engaging blog posts on their websites, run targeted social media campaigns and perform SEO to dominate the search result results for user queries. All this help them attract the targeted audience to walk through their offered services. Lead Capture: Once the user come to the website or landing page. He see’s the verities of services companies offering. If he showed little bit interest in these service, he asked to submit form of contact via contact form. Lead Qualification: After user submitted contact details the team of sales Development Representatives review that lead to determine if it is a good opportunity or not. Lead Nurturing: If it is a good business opportunity the sales team of development representatives engage with that lead guiding him with right direction and providing valuable content. Conversion: Potential leads are converted into paying customers through a structured sales activities. Follow-Up & Retention: Businesses don’t forget the customers after the sale is done. They keep in touch with the customer after the conversion and build long-term relationship for referrals or if he need their services in future.
